text:
Mira: FYI — from the postmortem: we need a short remediation sprint to close the recurring routing/eviction pattern. I sketched an action queue in the doc https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1722200000 — please grab owners and ETA.
Tony: I can take 'runbook triage steps' updates. Will add concrete commands and a quick 'when to escalate' section. ETA EOD Thurs.
Eva: I'll own the mev eviction detection rule and the alert thresholds. Putting a PR in for dashboards by tomorrow.
Samir: Assign me to rollbacks/playback test cases — I want a small checklist for on-call to run after a canary.
Lindsey: We should also add a deliberate fallback policy to the playbook: if the dedicated tier has >30% queue growth for 10m, route to shared model with throttling. I'll draft language.
Mira: Great. Can everyone add a single-line summary + owner + due date to the bottom of the postmortem doc under 'Followups — short sprint'? That makes triage + tracking easier.
Tony: Adding triage snippet now. Suggest this command block under "Immediate triage":
```
# check recent eviction spikes
curl -sS "https://infra-api/metrics?metric=evictions&window=15m" | jq .
# look for sustained queue growth
redis-cli -h queue01 INFO | grep blocked_clients
```
Mira: Love that. Also include the quick rollback command and the canary checklist: one-liners only.
Samir: Copying minimal rollback for runbook: `redwood ctl rollback --service inference --to deploy-2026-03-10` — works in Dedicated. Adding to PR.
Eva: On alerts: propose new alert name `eviction_high_rate` (severity P2) with 10m eval and paging to infra-oncall. @sre-bot can you create the alert ticket once PR is merged?
sre-bot: Created ticket INC-7892 for `eviction_high_rate` alert and linked PR #4521. ETA workflow reminder in 48h. :white_check_mark:
Lindsey: A couple questions: 1) Do we have testing steps to validate the fallback routing? 2) Who owns rolling the config to Dedicated clusters?
Mira: 1) add integration test in the 'routing' CI that simulates saturated slot counts + verify fallback. 2) Ops (cc @Samir) will run the config roll once QA approves.
Tony: Also adding a short escalation matrix: on-call -> infra lead -> SRE manager, with exact paging windows (5m, 15m, 30m). Will push to runbook.
Eva: I'll instrument a small metric to detect 'recurrence' pattern: correlate eviction spikes over 24h windows and mark repeated incident candidates. That should help prevent repeated postmortems for the same root cause.
Mira: Perfect. Let's commit these edits by EOD Thursday. I'll run a quick sweep on Friday to confirm owners + close blockers. If anyone needs extra time, shout here.
Samir: Sounds good. I'll create the followup task list in JIRA after I finish the rollback test items.
Lindsey: I'll pair with Tony on the wording for the escalation steps so it's clear for on-call.
Tony: Ping me when you draft — will review quickly.
Mira: Thanks all — tagging final checklist for reference: [Followups] 1) Runbook triage commands (Tony) 2) Eviction alert + dashboard (Eva) 3) Rollback/checklist tests (Samir) 4) Fallback routing policy text (Lindsey) 5) Escalation matrix + paging windows (Tony) 6) Recurrence detector metric (Eva). Due: EOD Thu / verification Fri.
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: followup sweep on 1722310000 (Fri).
Samir: Noted. I'll update JIRA tasks INC-FUP-1722 and link to postmortem.
Mira: Closing loop here once tasks are in JIRA and PRs are linked. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
